# `quest` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "quest" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/quest/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Id of the quest; stable forever (saves track its state). |
| `title` | string | required | The quest’s name in the journal. |
| `titleKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `summary` | string | required | What the quest is about, as the journal first tells it. |
| `summaryKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `notes` | string | — | What the quest is for, for writers. |
| `givers` | list of ref → creature | — | NPCs who hand the quest out (the journal and map point at them). |
| `startWhen` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) that starts the quest. Omit: it is started by an effect. |
| `startWhen.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `stages` | list of object | `[]` | Optional sequencing, in order. The quest begins in `initialStage`. |
| `stages[].id` | id | required | Id of the stage, unique in the quest. |
| `stages[].text` | string | — | Journal text while the quest is in this stage. |
| `stages[].textKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `stages[].transitions` | list of object | `[]` | Moves out of this stage, evaluated while it is current (branching quests: the first condition that holds picks the next stage). |
| `stages[].transitions[].when` | object | required | Condition (logic DSL) that moves the quest on. The first to hold, in file order, wins. |
| `stages[].transitions[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `stages[].transitions[].stage` | id | required | The stage the quest moves to. |
| `stages[].transitions[].effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects applied in the same atomic batch as the move (e.g. set a fact). |
| `stages[].transitions[].effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `stages[].transitions[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `stages[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `initialStage` | id | — | The stage the quest starts in. Default: the first stage. |
| `objectives` | list of object | — | What the quest tracks. |
| `objectives[].id` | id | required | Id of the objective, unique in the quest; other logic names it. |
| `objectives[].text` | string | required | The journal line, e.g. "Find out who has been taking the books." |
| `objectives[].textKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `objectives[].optional` | boolean | `false` | Not needed to resolve; a bonus or a side thread. |
| `objectives[].hidden` | boolean | `false` | Not shown until complete (a surprise). |
| `objectives[].activeWhen` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) from which the objective is active. Omit: with its stage. |
| `objectives[].activeWhen.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `objectives[].stage` | id | — | Active only in this stage. Omit: in every stage. |
| `objectives[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"haveItem"` | required | The player holds the item. Completes while held and reverts when it is lost, unless `latch`. |
| `objectives[].params` | object | required |  |
| `objectives[].params.item` | ref → item | required |  |
| `objectives[].params.count` | integer ≥ 1 | `1` | How many. |
| `objectives[].params.latch` | boolean | `false` | Stay complete once reached, even if the item is later dropped or spent. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"deliverItem"` | required | The player hands the item to an NPC. |
| `objectives[].params.npc` | ref → creature | required |  |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"fact"` | required | A world fact has a value. |
| `objectives[].params.fact` | string | required | Key of a registered world fact. |
| `objectives[].params.value` | boolean or integer or id | `true` | The value to wait for. Default: true. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"entityState"` | required | A creature reaches a state. Prefer `removed` so non-combat solutions count. |
| `objectives[].params.creature` | ref → creature | required |  |
| `objectives[].params.state` | `"dead"` \| `"befriended"` \| `"fled"` \| `"subdued"` \| `"removed"` | required | The state to wait for. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"enterArea"` | required | The player enters an area (a trigger volume). |
| `objectives[].params.area` | id | required | Id of the area. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"talkTo"` | required | The player talks to an NPC. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"dialogueNode"` | required | The player reaches a node of a dialogue. |
| `objectives[].params.dialogue` | id | required | Id of the dialogue. |
| `objectives[].params.node` | id | required | Id of the node. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"learnCapability"` | required | The player learns a capability. |
| `objectives[].params.capability` | id | required | Id of the capability. |
| `objectives[].kind` | `"event"` | required | A named event is emitted (by an `emit` effect or a system). |
| `objectives[].params.event` | id | required | Name of the event. |
| `resolutions` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The ways the quest ends well (or at least ends). At least one. |
| `resolutions[].id` | id | required | Id of the resolution; written to the world as `quest.<id>.resolution`. |
| `resolutions[].approach` | `"combat"` \| `"stealth"` \| `"diplomacy"` \| `"magic"` \| `"trickery"` \| `"other"` | required | The way of solving it this stands for. |
| `resolutions[].when` | object | required | Condition (logic DSL) that resolves the quest this way. The first to hold, in priority order, wins. |
| `resolutions[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `resolutions[].priority` | integer | `0` | Higher wins when several conditions hold in the same tick. Ties: file order. |
| `resolutions[].effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `resolutions[].effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `resolutions[].journal` | string | required | The journal entry written when the quest ends this way. |
| `resolutions[].journalKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `resolutions[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `failures` | list of object | — | The ways the quest goes wrong. |
| `failures[].id` | id | required | Id of the failure, unique in the quest. |
| `failures[].when` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) under which the quest fails. |
| `failures[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `failures[].npcRemoved` | list of ref → creature | — | The quest fails when any of these NPCs is removed (killed, fled, gone). |
| `failures[].itemDestroyed` | list of ref → item | — | The quest fails when the quest copy of any of these items is destroyed. |
| `failures[].deadlineDays` | integer ≥ 1 | — | The quest fails this many in-game days after it started, if still open. |
| `failures[].effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Effects (logic DSL) applied together: all or nothing. |
| `failures[].effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "hasItem". |
| `failures[].journal` | string | required | The journal entry written for this failure, in the story’s voice. |
| `failures[].journalKey` | string | — | Localization key for the text. Default: `quest.<quest id>.<part>[.<id>]`. |
| `failures[].continuation` | object | required | How the story goes on. Required: a failure is never a dead end. |
| `failures[].continuation.kind` | `"startQuest"` | required | A successor quest begins in the same tick. |
| `failures[].continuation.quest` | ref → quest | required | Id of the quest that starts. |
| `failures[].continuation.kind` | `"setStage"` | required | This quest carries on in another stage. |
| `failures[].continuation.stage` | id | required | Id of a stage of this quest. |
| `failures[].continuation.kind` | `"resolve"` | required | This quest ends with a (bittersweet) resolution. |
| `failures[].continuation.resolution` | id | required | Id of a resolution of this quest. |
| `failures[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
